pilotScope: Complete one academic year for all canonical subjects, with Numbers, Letters and PHONIX explicitly covered.

tracks.coverage: PHONIX metadata and sound-first speech on every Letters game

subjects.displayName: Creative Arts, Music, Rhymes and Pretend Play

themes: family, water, weather and repeated routines
food, transport, nature and familiar home routines

objectives.comm-literacy: Respond to a familiar voice, name, song or picture through gaze, gesture or sound.
objectives.writing: Explore grasp, release and large mark-making movements with safe materials.
objectives.numeracy: Explore one, more, in, out, big and small through real objects and action songs.
objectives.science-nature: Notice safe textures, light, sound, water, leaves and familiar living things.
objectives.social-habits: Seek a trusted adult, accept a brief turn and communicate more or finished.
objectives.health-selfcare: Participate in handwashing, feeding, rest and tidy-up with close adult support.
objectives.movement: Practise reaching, grasping, crawling, walking, balance and safe pause signals.
objectives.creative-arts: Respond to a voice, beat, colour, scarf, song or mark-making invitation.
objectives.digital: Attend briefly with an adult to one large, calm reveal and stop when finished.

themes: names, colours, shapes and classroom routines
family, animals, weather, feelings and turn-taking
stories, transport, food, community and independent routines

objectives.comm-literacy: Point to or name a familiar picture, join a rhyme and order a two-picture story.
objectives.writing: Copy a large line, curve or circle through movement, tracing or finger play.
objectives.numeracy: Count actions or small groups from 1 to 3 and compare same, different, big and small.
objectives.science-nature: Match a familiar animal, sound, body part, weather picture or plant feature.
objectives.social-habits: Greet, share, identify a simple feeling and follow a short classroom routine.
objectives.health-selfcare: Recognise and join simple handwashing, food, water and safe-boundary routines.
objectives.movement: Imitate walk, run, jump, roll, balance and stop/go movements safely.
objectives.creative-arts: Copy a clap pattern, choose a colour or texture and join pretend play.
objectives.digital: Tap a large target, listen, retry calmly and hand the device back to an adult.

themes: listening, rhyme, colours, counting 1–5 and classroom care
letters, patterns, family, animals, food and healthy routines
picture-to-word links, story order, community, safety and independence

objectives.comm-literacy: Recognise a familiar sound, rhyme, picture word or selected letter through oral play.
objectives.writing: Make controlled lines, curves, circles, name marks and purposeful marks.
objectives.numeracy: Count and match groups from 1 to 5, compare more or fewer and sort by a visible feature.
objectives.science-nature: Observe a body part, sense, animal, plant, weather event or material and describe it.
objectives.social-habits: Name a family or class role, cooperate, ask for help and follow a shared rule.
objectives.health-selfcare: Demonstrate handwashing, tooth care, healthy choice, rest and stop/go safety.
objectives.movement: Coordinate a simple movement route, balance, roll, throw and manipulate safely.
objectives.creative-arts: Extend a rhythm or colour pattern and participate in song, collage or role play.
objectives.digital: Tap, match, replay audio and recognise gentle feedback without needing to read.

themes: oral blending, numbers 1–10, patterns, living things and routines
familiar words, comparison, shapes, materials, community and self-care
shared reading, number order, weather, transport and school readiness

objectives.comm-literacy: Blend an oral sound, match a familiar word to a picture and retell a short sequence.
objectives.writing: Form selected letters, copy a pattern and label a familiar picture with support.
objectives.numeracy: Represent, order and compare quantities from 1 to 10 using objects, groups and numerals.
objectives.science-nature: Classify, observe, predict and describe living things, materials, weather or growth.
objectives.social-habits: Sequence a social repair, identify a safe choice and participate in a community role.
objectives.health-selfcare: Explain and sequence hygiene, nutrition, exercise, rest and trusted-adult steps.
objectives.movement: Follow a balance, throw, catch, cut, thread, build or dance sequence.
objectives.creative-arts: Describe an art choice, sequence a song or story and use a local craft safely.
objectives.digital: Drag with support, follow progress cues and use retry, pause and exit safely.

themes: oral sentences, familiar reading, joining groups within 5 and classroom responsibility
sentence meaning, number bonds, measurement, nature inquiry and cooperation
transfer to short reading and writing, reasoning, safety and primary readiness

objectives.comm-literacy: Read or build a familiar word, answer a story question and compose a short sentence orally.
objectives.writing: Write a name, familiar label or short meaningful sentence with developing control.
objectives.numeracy: Model joining groups, number bonds and simple addition within 5 before extending when ready.
objectives.science-nature: Observe materials, weather, living things or health phenomena and explain a simple result.
objectives.social-habits: Explain a fair turn, solve a simple social problem and identify a responsibility or safety action.
objectives.health-selfcare: Apply a body-care or safety rule and explain a healthy routine with support.
objectives.movement: Plan and perform a safe movement sequence, adapting it for comfort and access.
objectives.creative-arts: Compose or extend a pattern, perform, retell a cultural story and reflect on a choice.
objectives.digital: Choose a safe mode, complete a short game chain, pause and exit independently or with support.
